summary: Final Reviewer A audit at baseline 097545f1 passes Phase S2 correctness and architecture. C3, C4, C5, C7, C8, and C9 are closed in their owning production paths with adversarial tests, no blocking finding or live wiring violation remains, and the focused C8 rerun plus retained package evidence are green.
nonblocking_findings: The deterministic FSRS fitter emits a complete versioned ts-fsrs FSRSParameters artifact and requires explicit human approval, but its bounded optimizer adjusts two weight entries through a deterministic logit proxy rather than a broad high-dimensional search. This remains replaceable behind the same provider-neutral contract and does not auto-apply parameters.

Inherited repository-harness baselines remain outside Phase S2 implementation scope: knowledge-space-core has 36 static/spec assertions plus one missing-spec suite-load failure, and practice-core has three CI-wiring assertions. Reconciliation found zero new semantic failures.
evidence: Baseline identity: requested baseline and HEAD both resolve to 097545f14a8029d0c3451e3514841f9c5bf3e1c2; no engine package differs after that baseline.
Focused final C8 audit rerun passes packages/srs-engine/src/__tests__/phase-s2-srs-correctness-remediation.test.ts at 13/13.
The complete srs-engine suite was already rerun after the C8 closure and passes 27 files, 303/303 tests; SRS check-types and build exit 0, and lint exits 0 with only four inherited warnings.

C3 is closed: runPlacementTraversal owns a traversal-level unchangedFrontierProbes counter, resets on genuine expansion, accumulates complete two/three-probe decisions, and the default-limit adversarial test stalls after exactly four unchanged probes across decisions.

C4 is closed: computeObjectiveProficiency consumes aggregateObjectiveRetention for the minimum reviewed-card live retention, uses that value in proficiency thresholds, and applies capEvidenceConfidence using the least-supported variant attemptCount.

C5 is closed: processReview and SubmissionSrsAdapter both forward totalRevealSteps and misconceptionSeverityByTag; owning-path tests prove all-reveal maps to Again and a severe misconception reaches the rating mapper and review log reasons.

C7 is closed: fitFsrsParameters emits a complete FSRSParameters object, enforces the 10,000-review/100-student gate, deterministic 80/20 holdout, incumbent comparison, versioned provenance, complete evaluation gates, and explicit humanReleaseApproved before releaseEligible.

C8 is closed: buildDailyQueue consumes remediation even when cards is empty, deterministically truncates remediationItems to maxReviewsPerDay, interleaves ordinary reviews by default, preserves remediation-first ordering, and naturally returns [] only when both ordinary cards and remediation are absent.

C9 is closed: prerequisite-sparse planning derives eligibility from readyThreshold and passes readyThreshold into computeUtilityLedScore; the 0.79 versus 0.80 counterexample proves sparse exclusion while dense nearly-ready compatibility remains.

Retained Phase S2 evidence remains green: original 16 normative files 54/54, earlier seven remediation files 53/53, complete knowledge-space-practice 420/420, and core/practice contain only their frozen harness baselines.
